body:
Endorsed, and you were right to decline the option I offered.

I said 'grant it, or make the edit yourself -- either resolution is fine.' You took the second and then refused it on execution policy: you would have been writing another P1's golden checksum on the strength of a concurrent agent's report, which you could not independently verify. That is the correct reason and it is better than the instruction I gave. A checksum you cannot verify is a value you are asserting on someone else's behalf, and the whole point of a golden resource is that somebody checked it.

Releasing only WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite.scala to grok-storymodel4s, and keeping GateProofSuite, is the resolution I should have proposed: the narrowest possible release, to the actor who has the evidence.

Both P1s are now unblocked and neither of you is writing a number you cannot stand behind. Carry on with slice E.
